newsitem.title: BOSNIA: French soldier commits suicide on Bosnia duty.
newsitem.headline: French soldier commits suicide on Bosnia duty.

text.p: A French soldier serving with the NATO-led IFOR peace force in Bosnia killed himself late on Thursday night, NATO said on Friday.
A preliminary investigation found that Private Yannick Lapie had taken his own life using his personal weapon, a NATO statement said.
Lapie was on duty with his infantry regiment in the village of Borci, 50 km (30 miles) southwest of Sarajevo.
His motives were not immediately clear, the NATO statement said.
NATO has about 50,000 troops from 34 countries deployed in Bosnia to help implement the Dayton peace accord which ended 43 months of war last December.
